headline: Pornhub 🕵️‍♂️ PROBED 🍆 Over Its AGE 🍑 CHECKS 📋
text:
Ofcom 📡 just LAUNCHED 🚀 a full-on INVESTIGATION 🔎 into Pornhub's 🍆 owner Aylo after getting majorly sketched 😬 out by how they're leaning on Apple 🍎 for some of those new age verification checks 🧐!! The regulator says Aylo may not have done enough due DILIGENCE 🧪 and TESTING 🧪 before rolling it out which means the whole system might NOT 🚫 be highly effective at keeping kids 👦 from sliding into that adult content 🍑!! Under the UK's Online Safety Act 📜 sites have to use highly effective age assurance to make sure users are over 18 but they get to pick their own method which is exactly why Ofcom is now edging 🖐️ this whole situation to see if Aylo actually did the necessary homework 📚 before implementing Apple's 🍎 tech!!

George Lusty 🧔 Ofcom's Director of Enforcement straight up said online age checks are a VITAL 🛡️ protection to stop children from bumping into inappropriate or harmful material including straight up PORNOGRAPHY 🍆!! He expects tech firms to make sure those age checks are highly effective BEFORE they drop them on users or else kids stay at RISK ⚠️!! But Aylo is fighting back HARD 💪 claiming after experimenting in multiple markets their Apple-based system provides SIGNIFICANTLY stronger protection than anything else currently available in the UK market right now!! They even dropped that Ofcom had previously praised 🍎 Apple's technology as a real WIN 🏆 for children and families which is some serious receipts 📜 energy!!

In a lengthy statement to the BBC 📺 Aylo strongly defended its age verification system while stressing it would COOPERATE 🤝 fully with the investigation!! They argue that forcing individual porn sites to check ages just DRIVES 🚗 users over to riskier unregulated sites that aren't following Ofcom's rules at all!! Research from the Lucy Faithfull Foundation even suggested those non-compliant sites are more likely to host harmful or illegal content and in some cases actual sexual images of children which is pretty DARK 🌑!! Iain Corby from the Age Verification Providers Association told the BBC he seriously doubts Apple can prove that each time someone hits the site it's still the same verified person who originally proved their age to remove the device filter!!

Under the Online Safety Act Ofcom can SLAP 💥 non-compliant companies with fines up to 18 MILLION 💷 pounds or 10 percent of their annual global turnover whichever is greater so Aylo better not slip up!! This probe is just the latest CLASH ⚔️ between the regulator and one of the world's most viewed porn sites period!! Back in October 2025 Pornhub said traffic from UK users had PLUNGED 📉 by more than 75 percent after they introduced more robust age checks thanks to the OSA!! Some folks are side-eyeing whether people are just hopping on VPNs 🕵️ to dodge the checks instead which would explain the wild drop!!

Then in January Pornhub announced it would straight up RESTRICT 🚫 access to its website in the UK blaming the tougher checks and only letting people with existing Pornhub accounts get in!! Aylo said the updates to the Act requiring age verification had not achieved its goal of protecting minors at all!! However by May they flipped it and said the site would be available again for some UK Apple users who had confirmed their age with the company's most up-to-date version of iOS 🍎!! Aylo keeps insisting their system is built different 🛠️ and way stronger than the alternatives while Ofcom remains down bad 😩 about the lack of due diligence which means this horny regulatory standoff is far from over folks!!
